A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that it is possible to engineer a cyanobacterial strain to produce glycerol in a photoautotrophic manner.
we successfully introduced a heterologous glycerol production pathway into the model organism Synechocystiscystis sp. and that this pathway can be regulated by salt stress.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the production of glycerols from cyanobacteria is possible and that it can be done in the absence of external carbon sources.
the photosynthetic production of chemicals in cyanobacteria is a feasible approach.
